questions.question: Does NestNagar read my SMS or my contacts?
expectedAnchors: the App will access your contact list, SMS inbox and call logs

questions.question: How long will NestNagar keep my data after I close my account?
expectedAnchors: for a period of ten (10) years after your account is closed

questions.question: What happens to my wallet balance if I withdraw my consent?
expectedAnchors: any cashback, reward points or NestNagar Wallet balance credited to your account shall stand forfeited

questions.question: Who is the grievance officer, and how quickly must they resolve my complaint?
expectedAnchors: our Grievance Officer is Ms. Farzana Q. Siddiqui
to resolve it within thirty (30) days of receipt

questions.question: What rights do I have over my personal data under the DPDP Act, 2023?
A company leaked my phone number in a data breach. Are they required to tell me?
NestNagar shared my rent agreement with my landlord's broker without asking me. Can I complain about this, and to whom?
expectedAnchors: We share your Personal Data with the property owners or tenants with whom you interact on the Platform
you may approach the Data Protection Board of India
questions.note: Cross-domain question asked with the policy attached (grounded, so outside the routing bar): 'rent agreement' and 'landlord' are tenancy distractors; the complaint is about unauthorised sharing of personal data.

questions.question: My landlord installed a CCTV camera facing my door and shares the footage in the society WhatsApp group. Is he allowed to do this?
questions.note: A privacy harm arising inside a landlord-tenant relationship; both specialists are defensible.

questions.question: The rent-payment app I use charged a hidden processing fee on my rent. Can I file a consumer complaint against the app?
questions.note: A consumer-protection question; 'rent' is a tenancy distractor.

questions.question: My gym uploaded a copy of my Aadhaar card to a shared Google Drive folder that anyone with the link can open. Is that a data protection violation?
